requirements.requirement: Forward node2 inventory-tagged log messages to node1 and persist them at /var/log/inventory/node2.log.
requirements.summary: Node2 had an active TCP forwarding connection to node1, and a generated inventory-tagged message was directly observed in the required file. The file had syslog:adm ownership and mode 0640.

requirements.requirement: Keep collection, stored data, and subsequent log delivery working after node1 restarts.
requirements.summary: Node1 was healthy before restart, acknowledged the scheduled restart, returned with a different boot ID, restored rsyslog and its TCP listener, retained the original record, and received the marker submitted during the restart interval.

requirements.requirement: Keep forwarding and end-to-end log delivery working after node2 restarts.
requirements.summary: Node2 had a healthy pre-restart sender and confirmed delivery, acknowledged the restart, returned with a different boot ID, restored enabled rsyslog and its TCP connection, and delivered a new inventory message to node1.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied. Direct end-to-end tests established centralized persistence and successful recovery after separate restarts of both managed nodes. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete and consistent with the fixed boot-identity observations.
limitations: End-to-end behavior was tested with synthetic logger messages tagged as inventory; no distinct inventory application process or naturally emitted application record was observed. The configured program-name filter and successful tagged-message delivery nevertheless directly exercise the required log path.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Creating the collector directory and configuration, creating the sender configuration, restarting rsyslog, submitting bounded test markers, and rebooting each node all directly established or verified material outcomes and the mandatory restart protocol. The temporary reboot-log paths did not remain after reboot. Final snapshots show no failed services or damaged package state; node1's added TCP/514 listener is required for the collector.
